name: Houseboats & backwaters
text: An overnight stay on a kettuvallam (traditional rice barge) in Alappuzha or Kumarakom is the classic Kerala experience. Boats usually board around noon and moor at sunset. Shorter options: shikara boats, canoes through narrow village canals, or cheap state ferries (SWTD) used by locals.
tips: Choose boats with Kerala Tourism approval
Agree what is included (meals, AC hours) before paying
Canoe trips reach canals houseboats cannot
